references.text: Continuation of the instructions regarding the gold braiding to be used with the settings (mishbetsot) for attaching the breastpiece.
Describes how the gold chains are to be attached to the settings on the ephod, illustrating the practical use of the gold braiding.
Fulfillment of the command to make gold settings; here the actual execution of the work is described.
Detailed description of how the gold settings and braiding were made for the breastpiece.
Refers to the engraving work on stones with gold settings for the onyx stones on the shoulder pieces.
Both verses describe the same construction detail (gold chains/braiding) for the high priest's breastplate.
Both verses are part of the same instructional sequence for the breastplate; the braiding (v.13) is attached via the rings (v.23).
